newsitem.title: USA: AM Intl acquisitor proposes lower offer.
newsitem.headline: AM Intl acquisitor proposes lower offer.

text.p: AM International Inc said Friday that Pacholder Associates Inc is proposing to amend its merger agreement to reduce the amount AM shareholders would receive to $4.50 a share from $5.
AM's board said it plans to conisder the proposed amendment next week.

In making this proposal, AM said Pacholder indicated that revised financial projections of cash flow call into question the ability to meet certain liquidity levels required under the terms of the purchaser's financing commitment.
AM spokesmen were not immediately available for further comment.
AM International sells and services graphics arts products. The company's stock was at 4-1/8, off 1/4.
